title: Ship something weak, or ask for more time
situation: Your team of three promised the university's first-year office a simple web page that answers new students' common questions. It is due to go live on Monday, before orientation week. It is Friday evening: the page works, but half the answers have not been checked, and the search often shows the wrong result. Aliya, the office's student coordinator who asked for the page, calls to confirm the launch.
yourRole: You lead the team that builds the page.
goal: Decide what goes live and when, and tell Aliya. There is no single right way to do it.

character.name: Aliya
character.role: Student coordinator at the first-year office, the person the page is for
character.wants: Something live on Monday that she can announce at orientation

hiddenMotive: She has already put the page's link into the printed orientation booklet.
